messages:
Maria Chen: FYI I hit a weird support case where the console recommend-split UI suggested splits but our internal SDK ignored it and we got 413s. root cause looks like the SDK-runner didn't wait for the suggestor check and the runtime rejected at ingress. need a concrete plan to make preflight suggestions enforceable but safe.
Alex Gupta: can you paste the exact 413 response payload from the runtime? want to see what we expose to callers.
Maria Chen: here's the runtime response we saw in logs:

```
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
Content-Type: application/json
Body: {
  "error": "payload_too_large",
  "message": "Request exceeds per-request unit limit; see https://console.redwood.ai/org/alpha/suggestor for split suggestions",
  "debug_id": "dbg_9f8a2",
  "doc_link": "https://redwood-internal/help/embeds/splitting"
}
```

We added the doc_link in the 413 to reduce tickets, that helped.
Jing Li: routing note: runtime currently enforces hard unit limit after preflight routing. Preflight header (`X-Embed-Units-Estimate`) is advisory and unauthenticated. If SDKs start trusting console suggestions, we need a way for the runtime to verify the estimate hasn't been tampered with.
Sam Patel: my ops worry: signed estimates sound great but what about revocation? e.g., organ rotates keys or TTLs expire while SDKs queue requests for CI jobs.
Alex Gupta: design proposal: the suggestor returns an estimate object with fields: `units_estimate`, `splits` (offsets), `issued_at`, `ttl_seconds`, and `sig`. The sig = HMAC_SHA256(org_key, units_estimate|issued_at|ttl). SDKs attach the whole estimate JSON in `X-Embed-Estimate` header base64-encoded. Runtime validates HMAC against our KMS-backed org key and rejects if expired or sig mismatch.
Jing Li: validation is cheap. router already looks up org metadata for quotas. we'll add HMAC verify early in ingress path. if sig valid and estimate within allowed safety margin (+/- 30%), router can pick split-aware route and bypass the biggest fast-path splitting.
Maria Chen: for UX, console should show an "Insert SDK snippet" button that returns the split-aware client code with the encoded header. snippet should include a small helper that retries with the suggestor splits on 413.
Sam Patel: retries need backoff and idempotency guarantees. If a client blindly retries the full payload after 413 we'll amplify load. SDK snippet should instead honor the split offsets and send N smaller requests concurrently up to a concurrency cap. That will reduce retries.
Alex Gupta: telemetry: we want to be able to answer "what fraction of suggested estimates were used by SDKs" and "how many 413s occurred after a suggestor-issued estimate". New counters: `suggestor.issued`, `suggestor.used_by_sdk`, `ingress.413.post_estimate`, `preflight.hmac.verify_fail`, `preflight.hmac.expired`. Also histogram `preflight.estimate_error_pct` (abs((actual-units)/estimate)/estimate*100).
Jing Li: add trace attributes: `preflight.estimate.sig_ok` (true/false), `preflight.estimate.ttl_remaining_ms`, `preflight.estimate.src` (`console`|`sdk`|`other`). That will help drill into mismatch cases.
Maria Chen: rollout plan: 1) create suggestor v1 (read-only) and SDK helper that can opt-in; 2) runtime HMAC verification behind feature flag; 3) canary to 5 orgs with monitoring rules. If `ingress.413.post_estimate` increases >10% relative to baseline, automatically disable HMAC acceptance.
Sam Patel: and add playbook: if `preflight.hmac.verify_fail` > 0.5% of requests in 15m for a canary org, page oncall and revert the flag. Also set alert for `preflight.estimate_error_pct` P99 > 50%.
Alex Gupta: for billing transparency: console should show per-model estimate deltas. Suggestor should calculate rough E2E latency delta and unit delta per split plan. We'll expose `estimated_latency_ms` and `estimated_unit_change_pct` in the suggestor response.
Jing Li: router change: when sig_ok && ttl_remaining_ms > 0 && estimate within safety margin, attach a routing tag `route_hint=split` so downstream sharding/pool selection can pick small-batch pools. Otherwise set `route_hint=none`. Also log fallback reason: `sig_expired`, `sig_bad`, `estimate_too_low` etc.
Maria Chen: SDK snippet example we want to ship in console (pseudo-js):

```js
// insert header returned by console suggestor
const estHeader = "eyJ1bml0cyI6..."; // base64 estimate
fetch('/v1/embeddings', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + KEY, 'X-Embed-Estimate': estHeader },
  body: JSON.stringify({ inputs })
}).then(async res => {
  if (res.status === 413) {
    // fail fast: call the suggest_split helper and send split requests
    const plan = await suggestSplitAndSend(inputs);
  }
})
```

Alex Gupta: implementational nuance: don't let SDKs send the header for orgs that haven't opted into console suggestions. we'll add `suggestor_enabled` flag on org config, and runtime will ignore estimates if unset.
Sam Patel: security: traffic shaping. signed estimates could be used to squeeze through quotas if org_key leaks. Make sig TTL short (e.g., 60s) and require estimate consumption to be within a few seconds of issuance for high-risk models. Also log `estimate.replay_detected` if same sig used > N times from different API keys.
Jing Li: we can include a nonce `issued_id` in the estimate and keep a short LRU of recently-consumed nonces for replay detection. memory cost small if TTL is short.
Maria Chen: dashboard needs: 1) per-org card: suggestions shown, suggestions applied, 413s after suggestion, sig verification failures; 2) per-model impact: unit delta and latency delta histograms; 3) canary rollup with health indicators.
Alex Gupta: I'll draft dashboard panels and an alert playbook. ETA 48h.
Jing Li: I'll prototype verify path and nonce LRU. ETA 72h.
Sam Patel: I'll update support docs and craft the text for the 413 `doc_link` page to show the snippet and an explanation of signed estimates. ETA 24h.
DevSDK-bot: NOTE: SDK release branch `embed-suggestor` created. CI job queued.
infra-bot: Canary deploy scheduled: canary orgs = [alpha-testers, beta-sdk], window = 2024-01-10T14:00:00Z. CI:build #4991 queued.
Maria Chen: great. let's reconvene after the canary window and validate telemetry. thanks everyone. :rocket:
